{"parentUuid":"01202b8b-b478-4062-9d36-ba4a3eb84177","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fcb47d80-c718-4a7f-8d69-f151c5afd68c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014tN3tdc6j2kMqsFDgDV2Ah","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Site export: the public site, written as static HTML from published posts only.\n\n`cms publish` calls export_site(). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written. A draft that reaches the output is a bug.\n  2. Every href is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"../posts/x.html\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves the site from a subfolder. Links are\n     percent-encoded too, so slugs with accents and ñ never break.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, markdown, settings\nfrom app.content import Post\nfrom app.dates import spanish_date\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TopicPage:\n    \"\"\"A topic's public page: every published post filed under it, newest first.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    path: str  # where it is written, from the site root: \"tema/alineación.html\"\n    posts: list[Post]\n\n\ndef post_path(post: Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a post's page is written, from the site root.\"\"\"\n    return f\"posts/{post.slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef export_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection, out: Path) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Wipe `out` and write the public site into it; returns how many posts it holds.\"\"\"\n    posts = content.published_posts(conn)\n    topics = {key: TopicPage(name, f\"tema/{content.slugify(name)}.html\",\n                             [post for post in posts if post.topic == key])\n              for key, name in content.TOPICS.items()}\n\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(settings.TEMPLATES / \"public\" / \"style.css\", out / \"style.css\")\n    env = _environment(list(topics.values()))\n    _write(env, out, \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\")\n    for topic in topics.values():  # all five, even when empty, so no topic link breaks\n        _write(env, out, topic.path, \"public/topic.html\", topic=topic)\n    for post in posts:\n        _write(env, out, post_path(post), \"public/post.html\", post=post,\n               topic=topics[post.topic], body_html=markdown.to_html(post.body))\n    return len(posts)\n\n\ndef _environment(topics: list[TopicPage]) -> Environment:\n    \"\"\"Templates for every page: the site title, and the topics for the menu row.\"\"\"\n    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n                      autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]))\n    env.filters[\"spanish_date\"] = spanish_date\n    env.globals.update(site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, post_path=post_path, topics=topics)\n    return env\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, out: Path, path: str, template: str, **context: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render one page to `out / path`. Its links go through href(), which turns a\n    path from the site root into one relative to this page, percent-encoded.\"\"\"\n    up = \"../\" * path.count(\"/\")\n\n    def href(target: str) -> str:\n        return up + quote(target)\n\n    file = out / path\n    file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    file.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(href=href, **context), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\"\"\"Markdown rendering: Markdown text in, sanitized HTML out.\n\nUsed by Vista previa (and later by the review screens and the site export), so\nthe preview is always exactly what readers get.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\")\n\n# Text formatting, lists, blockquotes, code and links. Everything else goes,\n# images included: posts carry no photos.\n_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"hr\", \"strong\", \"em\", \"del\", \"s\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\",\n         \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"blockquote\", \"code\", \"pre\", \"a\"}\n_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\", \"title\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"}}\n# Links keep only full addresses. Relative ones (\"/admin\", \"//elsewhere\") would\n# point somewhere else on the public site, and published HTML has no root paths.\n_URL_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n\n\ndef to_html(text: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), tags=_TAGS, attributes=_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     url_schemes=_URL_SCHEMES, url_relative=\"deny\",\n                     link_rel=\"noopener noreferrer\")\n\"\"\"Accounts: who people are, and proving it with a password.\n\nPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email.strip(), _hasher.hash(password), nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console at http://localhost:8000/admin\n    uv run cms publish    # export site/ from published posts\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import closing\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.export import export_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"export site/ from published posts\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:create_app\", factory=True, port=args.port,\n                    reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        db.init(settings.DATABASE_PATH)  # a fresh clone exports an empty site\n        with closing(db.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)) as conn:\n            count = export_site(conn, settings.SITE)\n        print(f\"Wrote {settings.SITE} with {count} published post{'' if count == 1 else 's'}.\"\n              f\" Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {settings.SITE} 8001\")\n        if count == 0:\n            print(\"Nothing is published yet. For demo content run\"\n                  \" `uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py`, then publish again.\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n=== templates/admin/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"es\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}Administración{% endblock %} · {{ site_title }}</title>\n  <style>\n    :root { --navy: #0b2a5b; --navy-soft: #e8edf6; --ink: #1a1a1a; --line: #c9d3e6; --bad: #a3122a; }\n    * { box-sizing: border-box; }\n    body { margin: 0; font: 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; }\n    .site { background: var(--navy); color: --navy-soft: #e8edf6; --ink: #1a1a1a; --muted: #4a4a4a; }\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody { margin: 0; font: 17px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; }\na { color: var(--navy); }\n\n.stripes { height: 2.5rem; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0 1.25rem, #fff 1.25rem 2.5rem); }\n.band { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .25rem 1.5rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }\n.band a { color: #fff; }\n.site-name { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; }\n.menu, .topics { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem 1rem; }\n.topics { padding: .5rem 1rem; background: var(--navy-soft); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--navy); }\n.topics a { font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }\n\nmain { max-width: 44rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\nh1, h2 { color: var(--navy); line-height: 1.2; }\n.meta { margin: .25rem 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; }\n.posts { padding: 0; list-style: none; opacity: .85; }\n=== templates/public/topic.html\n{% extends \"public/base.html\" %}\n{% block title %}{{ topic.name }} · {{ site_title }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ topic.name }}</h1>\n  {% if topic.posts %}\n  {% with posts = topic.posts %}{% include \"public/_posts.html\" %}{% endwith %}\n  {% else %}\n  <p>Todavía no hay publicaciones sobre este tema.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"968ff7c3-b7b3-47c9-913b-ca0e487b3405","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:00:28.031Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Site export: the public site, written as static HTML from published posts only.\n\n`cms publish` calls export_site(). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written. A draft that reaches the output is a bug.\n  2. Every href is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"../posts/x.html\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves the site from a subfolder. Links are\n     percent-encoded too, so slugs with accents and ñ never break.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, markdown, settings\nfrom app.content import Post\nfrom app.dates import spanish_date\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TopicPage:\n    \"\"\"A topic's public page: every published post filed under it, newest first.\"\"\"\n    name: str\n    path: str  # where it is written, from the site root: \"tema/alineación.html\"\n    posts: list[Post]\n\n\ndef post_path(post: Post) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a post's page is written, from the site root.\"\"\"\n    return f\"posts/{post.slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef export_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection, out: Path) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Wipe `out` and write the public site into it; returns how many posts it holds.\"\"\"\n    posts = content.published_posts(conn)\n    topics = {key: TopicPage(name, f\"tema/{content.slugify(name)}.html\",\n                             [post for post in posts if post.topic == key])\n              for key, name in content.TOPICS.items()}\n\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    shutil.copyfile(settings.TEMPLATES / \"public\" / \"style.css\", out / \"style.css\")\n    env = _environment(list(topics.values()))\n    _write(env, out, \"index.html\", \"public/home.html\")\n    for topic in topics.values():  # all five, even when empty, so no topic link breaks\n        _write(env, out, topic.path, \"public/topic.html\", topic=topic)\n    for post in posts:\n        _write(env, out, post_path(post), \"public/post.html\", post=post,\n               topic=topics[post.topic], body_html=markdown.to_html(post.body))\n    return len(posts)\n\n\ndef _environment(topics: list[TopicPage]) -> Environment:\n    \"\"\"Templates for every page: the site title, and the topics for the menu row.\"\"\"\n    env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n                      autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]))\n    env.filters[\"spanish_date\"] = spanish_date\n    env.globals.update(site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE, post_path=post_path, topics=topics)\n    return env\n\n\ndef _write(env: Environment, out: Path, path: str, template: str, **context: Any) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Render one page to `out / path`. Its links go through href(), which turns a\n    path from the site root into one relative to this page, percent-encoded.\"\"\"\n    up = \"../\" * path.count(\"/\")\n\n    def href(target: str) -> str:\n        return up + quote(target)\n\n    file = out / path\n    file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    file.write_text(env.get_template(template).render(href=href, **context), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\"\"\"Markdown rendering: Markdown text in, sanitized HTML out.\n\nUsed by Vista previa (and later by the review screens and the site export), so\nthe preview is always exactly what readers get.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\")\n\n# Text formatting, lists, blockquotes, code and links. Everything else goes,\n# images included: posts carry no photos.\n_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"hr\", \"strong\", \"em\", \"del\", \"s\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\",\n         \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\", \"blockquote\", \"code\", \"pre\", \"a\"}\n_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\", \"title\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"}}\n# Links keep only full addresses. Relative ones (\"/admin\", \"//elsewhere\") would\n# point somewhere else on the public site, and published HTML has no root paths.\n_URL_SCHEMES = {\"http\", \"https\", \"mailto\"}\n\n\ndef to_html(text: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text), tags=_TAGS, attributes=_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     url_schemes=_URL_SCHEMES, url_relative=\"deny\",\n                     link_rel=\"noopener noreferrer\")\n\"\"\"Accounts: who people are, and proving it with a password.\n\nPasswords are stored only as argon2 hashes and are never logged.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import InvalidHashError, VerificationError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    nickname: str | None\n    role: str\n    active: bool\n\n    @property\n    def is_leader(self) -> bool:\n        return self.role == \"admin\"\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], nickname=row[\"nickname\"],\n                role=row[\"role\"], active=bool(row[\"active\"]))\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str, role: str,\n                nickname: str | None = None, active: bool = True) -> User:\n    now = db.now()\n    with conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, role, active,\"\n            \" created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (email.strip(), _hasher.hash(password), nickname, role, int(active), now, now),\n        )\n    user = get_user(conn, cursor.lastrowid)\n    assert user is not None\n    return user\n\n\ndef get_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef active_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None once their account is inactive.\"\"\"\n    user = get_user(conn, user_id)\n    return user if user and user.active else None\n\n\ndef authenticate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The active user with this email and password, or None.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\", (email.strip(),)).fetchone()\n    if row is None or not row[\"active\"]:\n        return None\n    try:\n        _hasher.verify(row[\"password_hash\"], password)\n    except (VerificationError, InvalidHashError):\n        return None\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef list_users(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, the leader's first, then by email.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'admin' DESC, email\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console at http://localhost:8000/admin\n    uv run cms publish    # export site/ from published posts\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import closing\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.export import export_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"export site/ from published posts\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:create_app\", factory=True, port=args.port,\n                    reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        db.init(settings.DATABASE_PATH)  # a fresh clone exports an empty site\n        with closing(db.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)) as conn:\n            count = export_site(conn, settings.SITE)\n        print(f\"Wrote {settings.SITE} with {count} published post{'' if count == 1 else 's'}.\"\n              f\" Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {settings.SITE} 8001\")\n        if count == 0:\n            print(\"Nothing is published yet. For demo content run\"\n                  \" `uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py`, then publish again.\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n input[type=email], input[type=password], input[type=text] { width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }\n    select { width: 100%; max-width: 24rem; padding: .4rem; font: inherit; }\n    textarea { width: 100%; padding: .4rem; font: 15px/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; }\n    button { font: inherit; padding: .5rem 1rem; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--navy); var(--bad); color: #fff; }\n    .notice { background: var(--navy-soft); border-left: 4px solid var(--navy); padding: .5rem .75rem; }\n    .help, .meta { color: #4a4a4a; font-size: .9rem; margin: .preview-body { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }\n    .preview-body pre { overflow-x: auto; background: var(--navy-soft); padding: .5rem; }\n    .side-by-side { display: grid; grid-template-columns: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: flex-end; margin: 1rem 0; }\n    .filters label { margin-top: 0; }\n    .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }\n    table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }\n    th, td { text-align: left; padding: .4rem .6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }\n    th { background: var(--navy-soft); }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header class=\"site\">\n    <strong>{{ site_title }}</strong>\n    {% if user %}\n    <nav class=\"menu\" aria-label=\"Menú de administración\">\n      <a href=\"{{ url_for('dashboard') }}\">Panel</a>\n      <a href=\"{{ </nav>\n    {% endif %}\n  </header>\n  <main>\n    {% if message %}<p class=\"notice\" role=\"status\">{{ message }}</p>{% endif %}\n    {% block content %}{% endblock %}\n <tr><th>Título</th><th>Tema</th><th>Apodo</th><th>Estado</th><th>Última actualización</th></tr>\n      </thead>\n      <tbody>\n        {% for post in posts %}\n        <tr>\n          <td><a \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block title %}Panel{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>Hola, {{ user.nickname }}</h1>\n  <p>Bienvenido al panel de {{ site_title }}.</p>\n  <h2>Publicaciones</h2>\n Si la despublicas vuelve a ser borrador, y desaparece del sitio público con la próxima actualización del sitio.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Despublicar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% elif post and may_publish(user, post) %}\n  <form class=\"lifecycle\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ url_for('publish_post', post_id=post.id) }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p class=\"help\">Se publica la versión guardada: guarda antes tus cambios. Si quieres corregir algo, retírala: vuelve a ser borrador.</p>\n    <button type=\"submit\">Retirar</button>\n  </form>\n  {% else %}\n  <p class=\"help\">Solo puedes leerla: cada miembro cambia únicamente lo que escribió.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n  <div class=\"preview-body\">{{ body_html | safe }}</div>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ url_for('content') }}\">Volver a las publicaciones</a></p>\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/admin/_post_meta.html\n<p class=\"meta\">\n  {{ post.topic_name }} · {{ post.status_name }} · de {{ post.author_nickname or \"—\" }} ·\n  Creada: {{ post.created_at | monterrey_time }} ·\n  Última actualización: {{ post.updated_at | monterrey_time }}\n  {%- if post.first_published_at %} ·\n  Publicada por primera vez: {{ post.first_published_at | monterrey_time }}{% endif %}\n</p>\n=== templates/public/_posts.html\n<ul class=\"posts\">\n  {% for post in posts %}\n  <li>\n    <a href=\"{{ href(post_path(post)) }}\">{{ post.title }}</a>\n    <p class=\"meta\">{{ post.author_nickname }} · {{ post.first_published_at | spanish_date }}</p>\n  </li>\n  {% endfor %}\n</ul>\n=== templates/public/base.html\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"es\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ site_title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ href('style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header>\n    <div class=\"stripes\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n    <div class=\"band\">\n      <a class=\"site-name\" href=\"{{ href('index.html') }}\">{{ site_title }}</a>\n      <nav class=\"menu\" aria-label=\"Menú\">\n        <a href=\"{{ href('index.html') }}\">Inicio</a>\n      </nav>\n    </div>\n    <nav class=\"topics\" aria-label=\"Temas\">\n      {% for topic in topics %}<a href=\"{{ href(topic.path) }}\">{{ topic.name }}</a>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </nav>\n  </header>\n  <main>\n    {% block content %}{% endblock %}\n  </main>\n  <footer>\n    <p class=\"disclaimer\">Sitio de aficionados. Sin afiliación con el Club de Fútbol Monterrey.</p>\n    <p class=\"disclaimer\" lang=\"en\">Fan site, not affiliated with Club de Fútbol Monterrey.</p>\n  </footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== templates/public/home.html\n{% extends \"public/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ site_title }}</h1>\n  <p>Lo que opinamos los aficionados de Rayados, tema por tema.</p>\n  {% for topic in topics if topic.posts %}\n  <section>\n    <h2><a href=\"{{ href(topic.path) }}\">{{ topic.name }}</a></h2>\n    {% with posts = topic.posts[:3] %}{% include \"public/_posts.html\" %}{% endwith %}\n    <p><a href=\"{{ href(topic.path) }}\">Ver todos</a></p>\n  </section>\n  {% else %}\n  <p>Todavía no hay publicaciones.</p>\n  {% endfor %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/public/post.html\n{% extends \"public/base.html\" %}\n{% block title %}{{ post.title }} · {{ site_title }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <article>\n    <h1>{{ post.title }}</h1>\n    <p class=\"meta\">Por {{ post.author_nickname }} · <a href=\"{{ href(topic.path) }}\">{{ topic.name }}</a></p>\n    <p class=\"meta\">Publicado el {{ post.first_published_at | spanish_date }}\n      {%- if post.edited_at %} · Actualizado el {{ post.edited_at | spanish_date }}{% endif %}</p>\n    <div class=\"body\">{{ body_html | safe }}</div>\n  </article>\n{% endblock %}\n=== templates/public/style.css\n/* The public site: navy and white, with rayas across the top of every page. */\n:root { --navy: #0b2a5b; --navy-soft: #e8edf6; --ink: #1a1a1a; --muted: #4a4a4a; }\n* { box-sizing: border-box; }\nbody { margin: 0; font: 17px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; }\na { color: var(--navy); }\n\n.stripes { height: 2.5rem; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0 1.25rem, #fff 1.25rem 2.5rem); }\n.band { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: .25rem 1.5rem; (#4): the site export writes the public site from published posts only.\n\nEach test name says which acceptance criterion of #4 it covers.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import unquote\n\nfrom app import cli, settings\n\n\ndef inside(html: str, tag: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The HTML inside the page's first <tag>, e.g. \"article\" for the post itself\n    or \"main\" for what the page says without the shared header and footer.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf\"<{tag}[^>]*>(.*?)</{tag}>\", html, re.S)\n    assert match, f\"no <{tag}>\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef text(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"What a reader sees of this HTML: tags dropped, spaces collapsed.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \" \", html)).strip()\n\n\ndef sections(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return re.findall(r\"<section[^>]*>(.*?)</section>\", html, re.S)\n\n\ndef list_items(html: str) -> list[str]:\n    return [text(item) for item in re.findall(r\"<li[^>]*>(.*?)</li>\", html, re.S)]\n\n\ndef links(html: str) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Each link's text -> where it points.\"\"\"\n    return {text(label): href for href, label in re.findall(r'<a href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</a>',\n                                                             html, re.S)}\n\n\ndef every_file_in(site) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Each exported file's path from the site root -> its contents.\"\"\"\n    return {path.relative_to(site).as_posix(): path.read_text()\n            for path in site.rglob(\"*\") if path.is_file()}\n\n\ndef test_export_writes_a_page_per_published_post_with_title_nickname_topic_link_spanish_date_and_body(\n        client_as, write_post, take_action, clock, export):\n    ana, leader = client_as(\"editor\"), client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = write_post(ana, title=\"Crónica del Clásico Regio\", topic=\"match\",\n                     body=\"Ganamos **3-1** en casa.\").headers[\"location\"]\n    take_action(ana, url, \"submit\")\n    clock.time = \"2026-10-05T01:15:00+00:00\"  # already the 5th in UTC; 19:15 on the 4th in Monterrey\n    take_action(leader, url, \"publish\")\n\n    post = inside((export() / \"posts\" / \"crónica-del-clásico-regio.html\").read_text(), \"article\")\n\n    assert \"<h1>Crónica del Clásico Regio</h1>\" in post\n    assert post\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_regenerates_site_from_scratch_from_the_database(\n        published_post, database_path, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):\n    published_post(title=\"Crónica del Clásico monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", database_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", site)\n\n    assert cli.main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n\n    assert not (site / \"posts\" / **Leader** (role *admin*): one person. Checks and publishes everything, writes the fan club's pages, creates and manages accounts, and puts changes online. Not technical.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:14:- **Member** (role *editor*): a fan with an account, created by the leader. Writes posts and submits them to the leader; cannot publish, cannot touch pages or accounts.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:15:- **Reader**: any fan visiting the public site on GitHub Pages, usually on a phone. No account; reads only.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:22:- A **public site**: static HTML regenerated from published content only and deployed to GitHub Pages. A home page with one section per topic, a page per topic, a page per post, and the fan club's pages in the menu. Navy-and-white, playful, unmistakably Monterrey, never official.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:29:2. **Two roles.** *Admin* = the leader: everything. *Editor* = a member: writes, edits and submits their own posts, reads everyone's posts, proposes edits to their own published posts. Editors cannot publish, cannot see or change pages, cannot manage accounts, and cannot run a site update. Enforced on the server for every route, never by hiding links.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:31:4. **Pages.** Fixed fan-club information: same fields as a post minus the topic, plus a menu-order number. Only the leader creates, edits, publishes, unpublishes and deletes them. Published pages appear in the public menu in menu order.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:32:5. **Admin console.** A dashboard with counts, a content list filterable by status, topic and (leader only) post vs page, and an editor with a *Vista previa* that shows the sanitized result.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:34:7. **Public site and site update.** `cms publish` regenerates the public site from published posts and pages only, with sanitized Markdown, a menu built from published pages, and relative paths only. `cms deploy` pushes it to GitHub Pages. The leader's *Actualizar el sitio* button does both.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:42:3. As the leader, I want the dashboard to count drafts, submitted posts, published posts, pending edits, pages and active members, so that I can see the state of the site without opening lists.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:46:7. As the leader, I want to filter the content list by topic and by post vs page, so that I can find things quickly.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:58:19. As the leader, I want to create, edit, publish, unpublish and delete pages, so that *Quiénes somos*, *Próximos partidos*, *Reglas de la casa* and *Cómo unirse* stay accurate.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:59:20. As the leader, I want to set each page's menu-order number, so that the public menu reads in the order I choose.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:60:21. As the leader, I want to be prevented from giving a page a name the site already uses (such as the home page or a topic page), so that nothing on the site is overwritten.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:92:50. As a member, I want a clear \"no tienes permiso\" page when I am refused, so that I understand what happened.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:96:51. As a reader, I want a home page with one section per topic showing its three newest posts, so that I can see what fans are saying about each subject.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:99:54. As a reader, I want the menu to list the fan club's pages, so that I can find the house rules and how to join.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:104:59. As a reader, I want to see the disclaimer on every page, so that nobody mistakes the site for an official Rayados site.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:115:- **Content.** Posts, pages and pending edits: storage, slug generation, and the post lifecycle as an explicit set of transitions (table below). Invalid transitions are refused here, not in the routes.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:117:- **Site export.** Renders every published post and published page, the topic pages and the home page into an output directory with relative, percent-encoded links. Called by `cms publish` and by the site update.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:118:- **Site update.** Export, then deploy (push the output to the `gh-pages` branch), then record the time of the last site update. The deploy step is injectable so tests never push. Called by *Actualizar el sitio* and mirrored by the `cms publish` / `cms deploy` CLI.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:119:- **Admin web layer.** Routes and Spanish templates for login, first-login nickname, *Mi cuenta*, dashboard, content list, post editor, page editor, review screens, users, site update, and the refusal page.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:120:- **Public templates.** Home, topic page, post page, page, shared layout with menu, topic links and disclaimer.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:128:- **Page**: id, title, slug (unique among pages, and never a reserved name), Markdown body, status (*draft* or *published*), menu-order number, author, created, updated and first-published timestamps.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:150:Pages have two statuses only (*draft*, *published*) and no submitted step, because only the leader writes them.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:158:- Anonymous requests to any admin route redirect to `/login`. An editor requesting a leader-only route, or acting on someone else's post, gets 403 with a Spanish refusal page that keeps the admin menu. Unknown ids get 404.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:173:- `/admin/pages/...` create, edit, publish, unpublish, delete, preview (leader only)\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:181:Made from the title: Unicode-normalized (NFC), lowercased, letters (including á é í ó ú ü ñ) and digits kept, every other run of characters replaced by a single hyphen, trimmed, capped at 80 characters. Example: *\"Crónica del Clásico Regio\"* → `crónica-del-clásico-regio`. A taken slug gets `-2`, `-3`, … A manually entered slug follows the same rules. A post's slug is editable until it is first published, then locked forever, so shared links keep working. Page slugs may not be a reserved name: `index`, `tema`, `posts`, `style`.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:189:- `index.html`: one section per topic in the fixed order, each with its three newest published posts (title, nickname, date) and a *Ver todos* link; a topic with no published posts is hidden on the home page. A Cerro de la Silla banner on top.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:190:- `tema/<topic-slug>.html`: all published posts in that topic, newest first. All five topic pages are always generated (an empty one says so), so no link ever breaks.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:192:- `<page-slug>.html`: a published page.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:194:- Every page shares a menu (*Inicio* plus published pages by menu order), a row of topic links, and the footer with a stadium silhouette above the disclaimer: *\"Sitio de aficionados. Sin afiliación con el Club de Fútbol Monterrey.\"* with *\"Fan site, not affiliated with Club de Fútbol Monterrey.\"* beneath.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:195:- Every `href` and `src` is relative (`../style.css` from nested pages) and percent-encoded, so accented slugs never break a link. File names are written in NFC.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:201:Navy and white, with vertical stripes (*rayas*) across the top of every public page, an original Cerro de la Silla silhouette on the home page, and a generic stadium silhouette (not labelled with any sponsor's name) in the footer. All drawings are inline vector graphics written for this site: no crest, logos, photos or image files. Fun to look at, but every page stays readable at 390 px with no horizontal scrolling. **Leader** (role *admin*): one person. Checks and publishes everything, writes the fan club's pages, creates and manages accounts, and puts changes online. Not technical.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:14:- **Member** (role *editor*): a fan with an account, created by the leader. Writes posts and submits them to the leader; cannot publish, cannot touch pages or accounts.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:15:- **Reader**: any fan visiting the public site on GitHub Pages, usually on a phone. No account; reads only.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:22:- A **public site**: static HTML regenerated from published content only and deployed to GitHub Pages. A home page with one section per topic, a page per topic, a page per post, and the fan club's pages in the menu. Navy-and-white, playful, unmistakably Monterrey, never official.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:29:2. **Two roles.** *Admin* = the leader: everything. *Editor* = a member: writes, edits and submits their own posts, reads everyone's posts, proposes edits to their own published posts. Editors cannot publish, cannot see or change pages, cannot manage accounts, and cannot run a site update. Enforced on the server for every route, never by hiding links.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:31:4. **Pages.** Fixed fan-club information: same fields as a post minus the topic, plus a menu-order number. Only the leader creates, edits, publishes, unpublishes and deletes them. Published pages appear in the public menu in menu order.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:32:5. **Admin console.** A dashboard with counts, a content list filterable by status, topic and (leader only) post vs page, and an editor with a *Vista previa* that shows the sanitized result.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:34:7. **Public site and site update.** `cms publish` regenerates the public site from published posts and pages only, with sanitized Markdown, a menu built from published pages, and relative paths only. `cms deploy` pushes it to GitHub Pages. The leader's *Actualizar el sitio* button does both.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:42:3. As the leader, I want the dashboard to count drafts, submitted posts, published posts, pending edits, pages and active members, so that I can see the state of the site without opening lists.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:46:7. As the leader, I want to filter the content list by topic and by post vs page, so that I can find things quickly.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:58:19. As the leader, I want to create, edit, publish, unpublish and delete pages, so that *Quiénes somos*, *Próximos partidos*, *Reglas de la casa* and *Cómo unirse* stay accurate.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:59:20. As the leader, I want to set each page's menu-order number, so that the public menu reads in the order I choose.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:60:21. As the leader, I want to be prevented from giving a page a name the site already uses (such as the home page or a topic page), so that nothing on the site is overwritten.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:92:50. As a member, I want a clear \"no tienes permiso\" page when I am refused, so that I understand what happened.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:96:51. As a reader, I want a home page with one section per topic showing its three newest posts, so that I can see what fans are saying about each subject.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:99:54. As a reader, I want the menu to list the fan club's pages, so that I can find the house rules and how to join.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:104:59. As a reader, I want to see the disclaimer on every page, so that nobody mistakes the site for an official Rayados site.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:115:- **Content.** Posts, pages and pending edits: storage, slug generation, and the post lifecycle as an explicit set of transitions (table below). Invalid transitions are refused here, not in the routes.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:117:- **Site export.** Renders every published post and published page, the topic pages and the home page into an output directory with relative, percent-encoded links. Called by `cms publish` and by the site update.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:118:- **Site update.** Export, then deploy (push the output to the `gh-pages` branch), then record the time of the last site update. The deploy step is injectable so tests never push. Called by *Actualizar el sitio* and mirrored by the `cms publish` / `cms deploy` CLI.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:119:- **Admin web layer.** Routes and Spanish templates for login, first-login nickname, *Mi cuenta*, dashboard, content list, post editor, page editor, review screens, users, site update, and the refusal page.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:120:- **Public templates.** Home, topic page, post page, page, shared layout with menu, topic links and disclaimer.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:128:- **Page**: id, title, slug (unique among pages, and never a reserved name), Markdown body, status (*draft* or *published*), menu-order number, author, created, updated and first-published timestamps.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:150:Pages have two statuses only (*draft*, *published*) and no submitted step, because only the leader writes them.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:158:- Anonymous requests to any admin route redirect to `/login`. An editor requesting a leader-only route, or acting on someone else's post, gets 403 with a Spanish refusal page that keeps the admin menu. Unknown ids get 404.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:173:- `/admin/pages/...` create, edit, publish, unpublish, delete, preview (leader only)\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:181:Made from the title: Unicode-normalized (NFC), lowercased, letters (including á é í ó ú ü ñ) and digits kept, every other run of characters replaced by a single hyphen, trimmed, capped at 80 characters. Example: *\"Crónica del Clásico Regio\"* → `crónica-del-clásico-regio`. A taken slug gets `-2`, `-3`, … A manually entered slug follows the same rules. A post's slug is editable until it is first published, then locked forever, so shared links keep working. Page slugs may not be a reserved name: `index`, `tema`, `posts`, `style`.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:189:- `index.html`: one section per topic in the fixed order, each with its three newest published posts (title, nickname, date) and a *Ver todos* link; a topic with no published posts is hidden on the home page. A Cerro de la Silla banner on top.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:190:- `tema/<topic-slug>.html`: all published posts in that topic, newest first. All five topic pages are always generated (an empty one says so), so no link ever breaks.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:192:- `<page-slug>.html`: a published page.\ndocs/tech-spec_web-cms_v1_opus-high_20261010.md:194:- Every page shares a menu (*Inicio* plus published pages by menu order), a row of topic links, and the footer with a stadium silhouette above the disclaimer: *\"Sitio de aficionados. {"parentUuid":"8e765adf-8f18-4796-b29d-e783c9cfa441","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fcb47d80-c718-4a7f-8d69-f151c5afd68c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/maximo/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `CONTEXT.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\"\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: #7 — pages managed by the leader, public menu"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"27b8c444-802e-432d-9788-de67e5400fd9","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:00:35.937Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_01QbN3nVDBgbSmntLTed6KrJ","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"660bc2b9-6920-42a9-963a-9574f3879318","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

members never see them.\n\nEach test name says which acceptance criterion of #7 it covers.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\n\ndef field(html: str, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The value of the editor's input with this name.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(rf'<input[^>]*name=\"{name}\"[^>]*value=\"([^\"]*)\"', html)\n    assert match, f\"no {name} field\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef test_leader_creates_page_saved_as_draft_with_title_slug_body_menu_order_author_and_timestamps(\n        client_as, write_page, clock):\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    response = write_page(leader, title=\"Quiénes somos\", body=\"Somos **aficionados**.\",\n                          menu_order=\"2\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = leader.get(response.headers[\"location\"]).text\n    assert field(page, \"title\") == \"Quiénes somos\"\n    assert field(page, \"slug\") == \"quiénes-somos\"\n    assert field(page, \"menu_order\") == \"2\"\n    assert \"Somos **aficionados**.</textarea>\" in page\n    assert \"Página · Borrador · de El Capi\" in page\n    assert \"Creada: 04/10/2026 12:30\" in page\n    assert \"Última actualización: 04/10/2026 12:30\" in page\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0d3e8ba5-4d17-47fe-bfe4-ce81af62e10d","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"660bc2b9-6920-42a9-963a-9574f3879318","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

The admin gate\n(`app.web.signed_in_user`) refuses a member on any of them, and the\naccess-control test reads this set, so protecting a new leader-only route means\nadding its name below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Post, Status\n\nLEADER_ONLY_ROUTES = frozenset({\n    \"users\",           # GET /admin/users: the list of accounts\n    \"publish_post\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/publish\n    \"unpublish_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/unpublish\n    \"send_back_post\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/send-back\n    \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed\n    \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve\n    \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back\n})\n\n\ndef may_use_route(user: User, route_name: str | None) -> bool:\n    return user.is_leader or route_name not in LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES\n\n\ndef may_change_post(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Save this post directly, or delete it: the leader, any post; a member, only\n    their own drafts (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader or (post.author_id == user.id and post.status == Status.DRAFT)\n\n\ndef may_propose_edit(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Propose an edit to this post: only the member who wrote it, once it is\n    published. The leader edits published posts directly instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return (not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n            and post.status == Status.PUBLISHED)\n\n\ndef may_use_editor(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Open this post in the editor and preview it: whoever may save it directly\n    or propose an edit to it.\"\"\"\n    return may_change_post(user, post) or may_propose_edit(user, post)\n\n\ndef may_submit_or_withdraw(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Submit this post, or withdraw it: only the member who wrote it. The leader\n    publishes or sends back instead (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return not user.is_leader and post.author_id == user.id\n\n\ndef may_publish(user: User, post: Post) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Publish this post: the leader only, and a member's post only once its\n    member has submitted it. The leader's own drafts go straight out (ADR-003).\"\"\"\n    return user.is_leader and (post.author_id == user.id or post.status != Status.DRAFT)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":18,"oldLines":6,"newStart":18,"newLines":10,"lines":["     \"pending_edit\",    # GET  /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit: published vs proposed","     \"approve_edit\",    # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/approve","     \"send_back_edit\",  # POST /admin/posts/{id}/pending-edit/send-back","+    # Pages are the fan club's own voice: only the leader sees or writes them.","+    \"new_page\",        # GET  /admin/pages/new: the empty page editor","+    \"create_page\",     # POST /admin/pages/new","+    \"page\",            # GET  /admin/pages/{id}: the page editor"," })"," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c3e78852-1776-437c-a686-085cf7bf0c9e","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"660bc2b9-6920-42a9-963a-9574f3879318","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Every route here is named in\n`policy.LEADER_ONLY_ROUTES`.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import content\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Page, PageFields\nfrom app.web import NotFound, flash, get_db, render, signed_in_user\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\", dependencies=[Depends(signed_in_user)])\n\n\ndef page_fields(title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"), menu_order: str = Form(\"\"),\n                slug: str = Form(\"\")) -> PageFields:\n    return PageFields(title=title, body=body, menu_order=menu_order, slug=slug)\n\n\ndef existing_page(page_id: str, user: User = Depends(signed_in_user),\n                  conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)) -> Page:\n    # An id that is not a number is as unknown as one that is not in the database.\n    page = content.get_page(conn, int(page_id)) if page_id.isdecimal() else None\n    if page is None:\n        raise NotFound(user)\n    return page\n\n\ndef render_page_form(request: Request, user: User, page: Page | None,\n                     form: PageFields | Page, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_form.html\", user, status_code=status_code,\n                  page=page, form=form, **context)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", name=\"new_page\")\ndef new_page(request: Request, user: User = Depends(signed_in_user)):\n    return render_page_form(request, user, None, PageFields(title=\"\", body=\"\", menu_order=\"\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\", name=\"create_page\")\ndef create_page(request: Request, fields: PageFields = Depends(page_fields),\n                user: User = Depends(signed_in_user),\n                conn: sqlite3.Connection = Depends(get_db)):\n    try:\n        page = content.create_page(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.ContentError as refused:\n        return render_page_form(request, user, None, fields, status_code=400,\n                                error=str(refused))\n    flash(request, \"Borrador de página guardado.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(request.app.url_path_for(\"page\", page_id=page.id), status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}\", name=\"page\")\ndef page_editor(request: Request, page: Page = Depends(existing_page),\n                user: User = Depends(signed_in_user)):\n    return render_page_form(request, user, page, page)\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"84299e67-0e2f-443c-9d8e-0c0108846d0b","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"660bc2b9-6920-42a9-963a-9574f3879318","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

field(published, \"csrf_token\")}).text\n\n    assert \"La página volvió a ser borrador.\" in unpublished\n    assert \"Página · Borrador · de El Capi\" in unpublished\n    assert \"Publicada por test_publishing_a_published_page_or_unpublishing_a_draft_page_is_refused(\n        client_as, write_page, take_action):\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = in refused.text\n    take_action(leader, url, \"publish\")\n    refused = take_action(leader, url, \"publish\")\n    assert refused.status_code == 400\n    assert \"Esta página ya está publicada.\" in published_page(title=\"Quiénes somos\", menu_order=\"1\")\n    url = published_page(title=\"Próximos partidos\", body=\"Sábado: Clásico Regio.\",\n                         menu_order=\"3\")\n .headers[\"location\"]).text\n    from_title = leader.get(write_page(leader, title=\"¡Cómo unirse!\").headers[\"location\"]).text\n    refused = write_page(leader, title=\"Reglas\", slug=\"Reglas de la Casa\")\n\n    assert field(first, \"slug\") == \"cómo-unirse\"\n    assert field(typed, \"slug\") == \"cómo-unirse-2\"\n    assert \"El enlace «cómo-unirse» ya era de otra página: quedó test_page_slug_can_change_until_the_page_is_first_published_then_never(\n        client_as, write_page, take_action, csrf_token):\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n    url = write_page(leader, re.search(r'<input[^>]*name=\"slug\"[^>]*readonly', editor)\n    assert save(leader, url, token, slug=\"reglas-de-la-casa\", title=\"Reglas de la casa\"\n                ).status_code == 303, \"saving aria-label=\"Menú de administración\">(.*?)</nav>',\n                     html, re.S)\n    assert menu, \"no admin menu\"\n    return re.findall(r\"<a [^>]*>(.*?)</a>\", menu.group(1))\n\n\ndef test_leader_content_list_shows_posts_and_pages_and_filters_posts_vs_pages(\n        client_as, write_post, write_page, published_page, cells, clock):\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n    write_post(leader, title=\"Watch party del Clásico\", topic=\"fan-club-news\")\n    clock.time = \"2026-10-05T18:00:00+00:00\"  # 12:00 on the 5th in Monterrey\n    published_page(title=\"Quiénes somos\", menu_order=\"1\")\n    write_page(leader, title=\"Cómo unirse\", menu_order=\"4\")\n\n    def rows(query: str) -> list[list[str]]:\n        return [row for row in cells(leader.get(f\"/admin/content{query}\").text) if row]\n\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows(\"\")] == [\"Cómo unirse\", \"Quiénes somos\",\n                                            \"Watch party del Clásico\"]\n    assert [\"Quiénes somos\", \"Página\", \"El Capi\", \"Publicada\", \"05/10/2026 12:00\"] in rows(\"\")\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows(\"?type=post\")] == [\"Watch party del Clásico\"]\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows(\"?type=page\")] == [\"Cómo unirse\", \"Quiénes somos\"]\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows(\"?type=page&status=published\")] == [\"Quiénes somos\"]\n    assert [row[0] for row in rows(\"?topic=fan-club-news\")] == [\"Watch party del Clásico\"]\n    assert rows(\"?type=page&status=submitted\") == []\n    listed = leader.get(\"/admin/content?type=page\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<option value=\"page\" selected>Páginas</option>', listed)\n    page_url = re.search(r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\">Quiénes somos</a>', listed).group(1)\n    assert \"Página · Publicada\" in leader.get(page_url).text, \"a page's title opens its editor\"\n    assert \"Ninguna página coincide con estos filtros.\" in leader.get(\n        \"/admin/content?type=page&status=submitted\").text\n\n\ndef test_leader_menu_and_content_list_lead_to_pages_and_a_new_page(client_as):\n    leader = client_as(\"admin\")\n\n    assert \"Páginas\" in menu_links(leader.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    listed = leader.get(\"/admin/content?type=page\").text\n    assert \"Todavía no hay páginas.\" in listed\n    new_page = re.search(r'<a class=\"button\" href=\"([^\"]+)\">Nueva página</a>', listed)\n    assert new_page and \"Nueva página\" in leader.get(new_page.group(1)).text\n\n\ndef test_member_sees_no_pages_in_their_admin_menu_or_content_list_even_when_asking(\n        client_as, published_page, write_page, write_post, cells):\n    published_page(title=\"Quiénes somos\", menu_order=\"1\")\n    write_page(client_as(\"admin\"), title=\"Cómo unirse\", menu_order=\"4\")\n    ana = client_as(\"editor\")\n    write_post(ana, title=\"Crónica del Clásico Regio\")\n\n    assert \"Páginas\" not in menu_links(ana.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    for query in (\"\", \"?type=page\", \"?status=published\", \"?status=draft\"):\n        html = ana.get(f\"/admin/content{query}\").text\n        assert \"Quiénes somos\" not in html and \"Cómo unirse\" not in html, query\n        assert 'name=\"type\"' not in html and \"Nueva página\" not in html, query\n    assert [row[0] for row in cells(ana.get(\"/admin/content?type=page\").text) if row] == [\n        \"Crónica del Clásico Regio\"], \"a filter the list does not offer is no filter at all\"\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_t06_content.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|Error |^E \" | head -6","description":"Add content list and menu tests for Búrlate del rival, de su racha o de su estadio todo lo que\"\n            \" quieras.\\\\n\\\\n\"\n            \"## Nunca: el ataque personal\\\\n\\\\n\"\n            \"Un ataque personal es una agresión contra una persona real (un jugador, un\"\n            \" árbitro, un aficionado, un periodista) o una amenaza contra una persona o un\"\n            \" lugar. No se publica nunca, se diga como se diga, ni aunque sea «de broma».\\\\n\\\\n\"\n            \"## Cómo se aplican\\\\n\\\\n\"\n            \"- Si una publicación cruza la línea, el líder la devuelve a quien la escribió\"\n            \" para que la corrija.\\\\n\"\n            \"- Quien insista en los ataques personales pierde su cuenta.\\\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n    PageFields(\n        title=\"Cómo unirse\",\n        menu_order=\"4\",\n        body=(\n            \"Para escribir en el sitio necesitas una cuenta, y las cuentas las crea el líder\"\n            \" del club de aficionados.\\\\n\\\\n\"\n            \"1. Escribe a [unete@albiazul.example](mailto:unete@albiazul.example) con tu\"\n            \" nombre y desde cuándo le vas a Rayados.\\\\n\"\n            \"2. El líder te responde con tu correo de acceso y una contraseña temporal.\\\\n\"\n            \"3. La primera vez que entres eliges tu apodo: es el nombre que verán los\"\n            \" lectores en tus publicaciones.\\\\n\\\\n\"\n            \"Antes de escribir, lee las reglas de la casa.\\\\n\"\n        ),\n    ),\n]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:''')\nedit(P, '''            if fields is LINEUP:\n                content.propose_edit(conn, post, PENDING_EDIT)\n''', '''            if fields is LINEUP:\n                content.propose_edit(conn, post, PENDING_EDIT)\n        for fields in PAGES:\n            page = content.create_page(conn, users[\"lider@albiazul.example\"], fields)\n            content.move_page(conn, page, content.PUBLISH_PAGE)\n''')\nedit(P, '''          f\" {len(PUBLISHED)} published posts, one per topic, and a pending edit to\"\n          f\" {LINEUP.title}. {"parentUuid":"1a9cecc5-d879-4e84-9f37-d8296fc0e45b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"fcb47d80-c718-4a7f-8d69-f151c5afd68c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018q8TdUaRnnBPr7QiR3C64N","type":"tool_result","content":"uv sync\ncp .env.example .env                  # optional: without it, .env.example is used\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py    # wipes and rebuilds cms.db with demo accounts\nuv run cms serve                      # then open http://localhost:8000/admin\nuv run cms publish                    # export the public site to site/ from published posts\npython3 -m http.server -d site 8001   # preview it at http://localhost:8001\nuv run cms deploy                     # put site/ online (the gh-pages branch)\n```\n\nDemo accounts (all fictional; passwords are the values in `.env`):\n\n| Email | Role | Nickname | Password |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `lider@albiazul.example` | leader (admin) | El Capi | `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` |\n| `ana@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Rayada de Corazón | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n| `beto@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Furia del Cerro | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n\nThe seed also adds one draft post written by Rayada de Corazón (open *Publicaciones*), one\npost by Furia del Cerro waiting for the leader's review (the *Esperando revisión* count on the\nleader's *Panel*), and one published post in each of the five topics, so the exported site has\nsomething in every section. Rayada de Corazón has also proposed changes to her published lineup\npost: the *Cambios propuestos* count on the *Panel* opens it, and the leader compares the two\nversions side by side before approving or sending them back.\n\n## What is here\n\n```text\n.claude/hooks/     the context meter and usage ledger (Exercise A lives in ctx_guard.py)\nscripts/           usage_report.py (Exercise B lives in spend()), check_submission.py, seed_demo.py\ntests/             the exercise tests, plus helpers such as client_as(\"editor\")\napp/, templates/   the T00 skeleton — every CMS feature is yours to build","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"e40488f8-a190-487b-b817-f66688592d70","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:11:41.778Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"uv sync\ncp .env.example .env                  # optional: without it, .env.example is used\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py    # wipes and rebuilds cms.db with demo accounts\nuv run cms serve                      # then open http://localhost:8000/admin\nuv run cms publish                    # export the public site to site/ from published posts\npython3 -m http.server -d site 8001   # preview it at http://localhost:8001\nuv run cms deploy                     # put site/ online (the gh-pages branch)\n```\n\nDemo accounts (all fictional; passwords are the values in `.env`):\n\n| Email | Role | Nickname | Password |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `lider@albiazul.example` | leader (admin) | El Capi | `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` |\n| `ana@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Rayada de Corazón | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n| `beto@albiazul.example` | member (editor) | Furia del Cerro | `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD` |\n\nThe seed also adds one draft post written by Rayada de Corazón (open *Publicaciones*), one\npost by Furia del Cerro waiting for the leader's review (the *Esperando revisión* count on the\nleader's *Panel*), and one published post in each of the five topics, so the exported site has\nsomething in every section. Run `uv run cms publish` to export them to site/.\n5\ncómo-unirse.html\nindex.html\nposts\npróximos-partidos.html\nquiénes-somos.html\nreglas-de-la-casa.html\nstyle.css\ntema\n  <header>\n    <div class=\"stripes\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></div>\n    <div class=\"band\">\n      <a class=\"site-name\" href=\"index.html\">Club de Aficionados Albiazul</a>\n      <nav class=\"menu\" aria-label=\"Menú\">\n        <a href=\"index.html\">Inicio</a>\n        <a href=\"qui%C3%A9nes-somos.html\">Quiénes somos</a>\n        <a href=\"pr%C3%B3ximos-partidos.html\">Próximos partidos</a>\n        <a href=\"reglas-de-la-casa.html\">Reglas de la casa</a>\n        <a href=\"c%C3%B3mo-unirse.html\">Cómo unirse</a>\n        \n      </nav>\n    </div>\n    <nav class=\"topics\" aria-label=\"Temas\">\n      <a href=\"tema/partido.html\">Partido</a>\n      <a href=\"tema/alineaci%C3%B3n.html\">Alineación</a>\n      <a href=\"tema/t%C3%A9cnico.html\">Técnico</a>\n      <a href=\"tema/fichajes.html\">Fichajes</a>\n      <a href=\"tema/noticias-del-club-de-aficionados.html\">Noticias del club de aficionados</a>\n      \n    </nav>\n  </header>\n  <main>\n    \n  <article>\n    <h1>Reglas de la casa</h1>\n    <div class=\"body\"><p>El líder revisa cada publicación antes de que salga al sitio, y la revisa con estas reglas.</p>\n<h2>Se vale: la tiradera</h2>\n<p>La tiradera a un club rival o a su afición (a Tigres, sobre todo) es parte de ser aficionado. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review the uncommitted working-tree changes since HEAD (2f025cb) for ticket #7 (T06). Ignore the pre-existing unrelated changes to .gitignore, notes/token-budget-plan.md, notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"8ead61ec-55f1-4c56-98d4-97ca4258ec2a","timestamp":"2026-10-11T17:12:42.898Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_017JZxDQU75You8PpQutGf1K","session_id":"9a7f3e0c-bc89-4928-8487-31a077b3ff91","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"660bc2b9-6920-42a9-963a-9574f3879318","version":"2.1.292","gitBranch":"main"}

Readers see this text.\n2. **CLAUDE.md, \"update the glossary rather than using both\".** The new idea of a post versus a page has four names: `kind` (`posts.py:102`), `type` (query string and template), `CONTENT_TYPES` (`content.py:36`) and \"Tipo\" in the UI. `kind` is also on Topic's _Avoid_ list. CONTEXT.md still defines Draft, Published, Unpublish and Slug as applying only to posts, and has nothing on menu order or reserved slugs.\n3. **Policy is meant to be the one place for \"may this person do this\"** (`policy.py` docstring; `web.py` says \"Templates ask Policy\"). The routes use `policy.may_manage_pages`, but the templates check `user.is_leader` directly (`base.html:58`, `content.html:3,10,13`). Older test files already copy helpers, but shared ones belong in conftest.\n- **Primitive Obsession / Data Clumps.** A `table: str` (\"posts\"/\"pages\") is passed alongside `item` into `_slug_for` (`content.py:211`), `_free_slug` (`:229`) and `_set_status` (`:362`), and is put into the SQL with an f-string. The item's type already tells you the table.\n- **Repeated Switches.** The code branches on \"post\"/\"page\" in `posts.py:110-112`, `content.html:2,4,73`, and the new `is page` Jinja test in `web.py`.\n- **Mysterious Name**\n  - `_validate_page` (`content.py:425`) returns the menu order, so it parses as well as checks.\n  - In `posts.py:109`, `pages` holds a boolean, but the name sounds like a list.\n  - `public/base.html:16` loops with `entry` over Page objects; the glossary avoids \"menu item\" for pages.\n- **Divergent Change.** `posts.py` now changes for page reasons (the type filter, `may_manage_pages`), but its docstring still says \"Posts: the content list and the post editor\".\n- **Ambiguous docstring.** At `export.py:71`, \"Templates for every page… the published pages for the menu\" uses \"page\" for both an HTML file and the domain Page in one sentence.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>102473</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>14</tool_uses><duration_ms>113484</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}
